checks.name: backend pytest suite (test_tscheck_admin_catalog_crud.py, test_tscheck_catalog_integrity.py, test_tscheck_session_isolation.py)
checks.evidence: Full-suite run: 8 passed, 1 failed. test_admin_cannot_see_own_qa_named_product fails consistently across repeated full-suite runs (isolated single-file run passes): admin-authenticated GET /products list and GET /products/{id} hide the admin's own freshly-created product 'tscheck-catalog-visibility-*' because its title matches the public QA-name filter (list_status=200 contains_id=False; single_get_status=404). Admin login itself succeeded via direct curl to /api/auth/admin/login (200, returns admin user object), so the earlier single failed httpx-client login inside the suite was a rerun-confirmed flake, not a credentials issue.

bugs.criterion: Pre-existing regression suite (not in current acceptance matrix)
bugs.description: Backend applies the public QA-name exclusion filter (titles starting with 'tscheck-') to admin-authenticated product list/detail endpoints, so admins cannot see their own freshly created QA-prefixed products in /api/products or /api/products/{id}. This filter should only apply to the public/unauthenticated catalog surface.
bugs.evidence: pytest tests/test_tscheck_catalog_integrity.py::test_admin_cannot_see_own_qa_named_product — AssertionError, list_status=200 contains_id=False single_get_status=404 for product id b24ac88e-5768-4906-8390-cd2bbd02eff3 (title 'tscheck-catalog-visibility-e0532de3'), reproduced twice in full-suite runs, passes when the file is run in isolation.

action_items: Backend bug above is unrelated to the five current SAFYRA palette/typography acceptance criteria (which all passed) but is a real, reproducible defect surfaced by the existing regression suite; recommend main agent scope a fix to the admin product visibility filter.
notes: Current briefing's 5 acceptance criteria (palette, typography, dark-surface readability, functional colours, locked structure) all passed via new/updated browser checks. Also re-ran the pre-existing full backend pytest suite per method step 2; one pre-existing test (catalog integrity, unrelated to this iteration's matrix) fails reproducibly outside isolation and is reported as a bug for the record. homepage-editorial-sections-visible check was updated in place (its two testid selectors referenced markup removed in a prior refactor) rather than left failing on stale expectations.
